title: Give the Open System Settings button a 48 dp tap area in settings-row-nodes
context: Wave 1 (#213) added an 'Open System Settings' StickerButton under the Daily reminder row, shown only when notification permission is refused. It is about 40 dp tall, below the 48 dp minimum settings-row-nodes enforces for Export, Reclaim space and Delete all, and no test or sweep state shows it because the test scheduler defaults to granted.
options: Add it to settings-row-nodes with a 48 by 48 test
Leave it and note the gap for the live macOS check
outcome: Owner chose: add it. settings-row-nodes gains lib/features/settings/sections/reminders_sound_section.dart and its test, with a test that the button's node is at least 48 by 48 dp.
